question: Who was the founder of the Mauryan dynasty?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the **founder of the Mauryan dynasty** and played a significant role in Indian history by unifying the Indian subcontinent under one empire.
 
• He established the Mauryan Empire around **321 BCE** after overthrowing the Nanda dynasty.
